name: mirage
text: Bid volume: the engine now shows why it rejects bids. Of about 1,200 candidate lines, roughly 360 fail 'at least 3 books must agree it is +EV', 320 fail 'at least 1 well-known book (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, Pinnacle) must be behind the price', and 270 are priced too far under Novig's best bid to ever fill. The first two are the quality rules you set on 10-25 ('at least 3 agreeing books'), so I have not loosened them without your word. The third protects against bids that never fill. Total bids up: 9-16 (0-20). Say if you want one relaxed (e.g. drop to 2 books for steady types, or allow bids further behind the best bid) and I will do it right away and log it. The engine was reset to run this code.
